description: An Integrated Plan for Water and Long-Term Ecological Resilience is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by American Rivers; Yakama Nation; Yakima County, Washington. Recognizing their vulnerability to drought and climate change, federal, state, tribal, and local partners in Washington’s Yakima River Basin developed a plan to meet their diverse needs for water into the future. Coverage: Washington (2015). The toolkit gives Washington as the location, 2015 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
